event_description: Fired when a user establishes a session via GitHub OAuth or magic link.
Fired when a user explicitly logs out.
Fired when a user is redirected to the Lemon Squeezy checkout page for a plan.
Fired when a Lemon Squeezy subscription lifecycle event is received (created, cancelled, expired, etc.).
Fired when a user successfully creates a new project.
Fired when a user deletes one of their projects.
Fired when a user creates a new API key for CI/CD access.
Fired when a user revokes an existing API key.
Fired when a free-tier user hits their monthly verification run limit.
Fired when a user requests an AI-generated explanation for a divergent run.
